summary: Refactored WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte into cohesive Svelte 5 subcomponents under apps/app/src/lib/features/workspace/configure/, splitting out Gizmo extension overrides, Pi extension overrides, skills, tool policy, and remove-workspace sections while preserving the parent file's import path/API and reusing the existing SkillList. A shared ConfigureSectionHeading and a types.ts for the reapply callback were extracted; the parent was rewritten to compose the new sections.
decisions: Extract one section per new component under configure/ (GizmoExtensionOverridesSection, PiExtensionOverridesSection, WorkspaceSkillsSection, WorkspaceToolPolicySection, RemoveWorkspaceSection) to keep each <=300 LOC
Reuse existing SkillList.svelte from features/settings rather than duplicating skill rendering, exposing installed-skills filtering and toggle/reset callbacks from the new section

Centralize the reapply-project-config busy callback (Promise<ProjectConfig | void>) in a shared types.ts and pass it down to extension sections so all override work funnels through one re-render trigger
Keep WorkspaceConfigurePanel.svelte at its original path so downstream imports and the public API of the panel are preserved
Add a small shared ConfigureSectionHeading.svelte component to avoid over-generalizing; only this and the types.ts are shared, the rest are co-located sections
errors: ripgrep regex parse error on a combined alternation pattern (unclosed group) — resolved by splitting into a single literal search for getByRole('switch'
